primary.outcome_definition: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of Death From Vascular Causes, Myocardial Infarction (MI), and Stroke

outcome_definition_source.description_verbatim: Participants with death from vascular causes, MI, or stroke. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. Intention To Treat (ITT) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcome_definition_source.endpoint_rank: PRIMARY (the first of TWO registered primaries; the second is 'Participants With Any Major Bleeding Event')
outcome_definition_source.death_term: DEATH FROM VASCULAR CAUSES -- not 'cardiovascular' and not all-cause. One of three different death terms across this pool's three ischaemic trials.
outcome_definition_source.arm_labels_are_inverted_in_this_object: THE REGISTRY'S POSTED RESULTS GIVE TICAGRELOR 864/9333 AND CLOPIDOGREL 1014/9291. This object stores 864/9333 under the label 'Clopidogrel' with role 'treatment', and 1014/9291 under 'Ticagrelor' with role 'control'. The COUNTS are right and the LABELS AND ROLES ARE BOTH SWAPPED, so the object as written says clopidogrel outperformed ticagrelor -- the reverse of the trial's finding. The registry's own arm types settle it: Clopidogrel is ACTIVE_COMPARATOR, Ticagrelor is EXPERIMENTAL.

primary.outcome_definition: Number of Subjects Reaching the Composite Endpoint of Cardiovascular (CV) Death, Nonfatal Myocardial Infarction (MI), or Nonfatal Stroke

primary.outcome_definition: Number of Participants With BARC Type 2, 3, or 5

outcome_definition_source.description_verbatim: Number of participants with first occurrence of clinically relevant bleeding episode, defined as Bleeding Academic Research Consortium (BARC) Types 2, 3 or 5 bleeding. BARC bleeding types range from 0 (no bleeding) to 5 (fatal bleeding).
outcome_definition_source.endpoint_rank: PRIMARY (sole). The registration declares only TWO outcome measures in total, one primary and one secondary.
outcome_definition_source.this_is_a_bleeding_endpoint: THIS IS A HARM ENDPOINT, NOT AN ISCHAEMIC ONE, and it is the trial's only registered primary. Pooling it with three ischaemic composites averages a bleeding rate with event rates that mean the opposite thing -- fewer bleeds is a benefit of REMOVING a drug. This is the defect that withdrew DOAC_CANCER_VTE and APIXABAN_ACS in this corpus.
outcome_definition_source.contrast: ticagrelor plus aspirin against ticagrelor alone. An aspirin-withdrawal question; no P2Y12 inhibitor is being compared with another.
outcome_definition_source.arm_labels_are_inverted_in_this_object: THE REGISTRY'S POSTED RESULTS GIVE PLACEBO+TICAGRELOR 141/3555 AND ASPIRIN+TICAGRELOR 250/3564. This object stores 141/3555 under 'Aspirin + Ticagrelor' as treatment and 250/3564 under 'Placebo + Ticagrelor' as control, so it reads as though ADDING aspirin halved bleeding. TWILIGHT found the opposite: dropping aspirin did. The registry's arm types settle it: Aspirin + Ticagrelor is ACTIVE_COMPARATOR, Placebo + Ticagrelor is PLACEBO_COMPARATOR.

primary.poolable_reason: THE FOUR TRIALS DO NOT ANSWER ONE QUESTION, AND ONE OF THEM DOES NOT MEASURE AN ISCHAEMIC EVENT AT ALL. This estimate averaged four different comparisons into a single pairwise odds ratio. (1) THE CONTRASTS DIFFER: PLATO is ticagrelor against clopidogrel; TRITON-TIMI 38 is prasugrel against clopidogrel; ISAR-REACT 5 is ticagrelor against prasugrel; TWILIGHT is ticagrelor plus aspirin against ticagrelor alone, which is an aspirin-withdrawal question and not a P2Y12 comparison. Four contrasts over three drugs plus an aspirin question is a NETWORK, and a network cannot be reduced to one pairwise pool. (2) TWILIGHT CONTRIBUTES A BLEEDING ENDPOINT. Its registered primary, verbatim, is 'Number of Participants With BARC Type 2, 3, or 5' -- described as 'first occurrence of clinically relevant bleeding episode'. It is the trial's ONLY registered primary. A harm endpoint was averaged with three efficacy composites, which is the same defect this corpus withdrew DOAC_CANCER_VTE and APIXABAN_ACS for. (3) THE THREE ISCHAEMIC COMPOSITES ARE NOT IDENTICAL EITHER: PLATO counts 'Death From Vascular Causes, Myocardial Infarction (MI), and Stroke' to 12 months; TRITON counts 'Cardiovascular (CV) Death, Nonfatal Myocardial Infarction (MI), or Nonfatal Stroke' to 15 months -- a different death term, NONFATAL restrictions the others do not carry, and a window three months longer; ISAR-REACT 5 counts 'Composite of death, myocardial infarction or stroke' to 12 months, where 'death' is unqualified and therefore all-cause. Three death definitions across three trials. (4) THE HETEROGENEITY ALREADY SAID SO: I-squared 91.0%, Q 33.4 on 3 degrees of freedom, and the per-trial estimates run from 0.55 to 1.37 -- ISAR-REACT 5 points the opposite way to the rest. Withdrawn: the displayed value 0.8371 (0.6576-1.0657) is not an estimate of anything one question could ask.

contrast_compared: PLATO ticagrelor vs clopidogrel; TRITON-TIMI 38 prasugrel vs clopidogrel; ISAR-REACT 5 ticagrelor vs prasugrel; TWILIGHT ticagrelor+aspirin vs ticagrelor alone. Four contrasts, no two alike. This is a network, and the page's own title calls it one -- 'ACS Antiplatelet NMA'.
endpoint_type: Three ischaemic composites and ONE BLEEDING endpoint. TWILIGHT's sole registered primary is BARC type 2, 3 or 5 bleeding.
outcome_definition: DIFFERS among the three ischaemic trials too
Death from VASCULAR causes (PLATO); CARDIOVASCULAR death with NONFATAL MI and NONFATAL stroke (TRITON); unqualified, therefore ALL-CAUSE death (ISAR-REACT 5).
follow_up_length: 12 months in PLATO, ISAR-REACT 5 and TWILIGHT; 15 months in TRITON-TIMI 38.
arm_labels: PLATO and TWILIGHT both store correct counts under swapped labels, and in both cases the swap REVERSES the trial's clinical conclusion. TRITON-TIMI 38 is confirmed correct against the registry's posted results; ISAR-REACT 5 posts no results and could not be checked.
heterogeneity: I-squared 91.0%, Q 33.4 on 3 df, per-trial estimates 0.55 to 1.37 with ISAR-REACT 5 pointing the opposite way. The statistic was in the object before today and nothing acted on it.

primary.poolable_reason_superseded_2026_08_18: The extractor recovered a pooled result from this page, so the page pooled these trials. Whether they SHOULD have been pooled is not established by conversion. -- That caveat was correct and was never acted on; it is now.
primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.
